vocabulary.definition: a light, fast sailing ship used by the Portuguese in the 15th and 16th centuries
vocabulary.example: The caravel was crucial for Portuguese explorers to navigate the seas.

vocabulary.definition: related to the sea or navigation on the sea
vocabulary.example: The maritime trade routes were vital for the expansion of trade between continents.

vocabulary.definition: set up on a firm or permanent basis
vocabulary.example: The Portuguese established trading posts along the African coasts.
The objective of the explorers was to find a new trade route to the Indies.

vocabulary.definition: exclusive control or possession of something
vocabulary.example: Portugal gained a monopoly on trade in the Indian Ocean.

vocabulary.definition: people or entities that act as a link between two parties
